name: token-optimizer-statusline
description: See your Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor context health, efficiency, and usage limits in the VS Code status bar.

enumDescriptions: Detect automatically: read whichever runtime (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) you've used most recently. Single-runtime setups just work; no setting to flip.
Always read cache files written by the Claude Code Token Optimizer plugin (~/.claude/token-optimizer/).
Always read cache files written by the GitHub Copilot Token Optimizer install (~/.copilot/token-optimizer/). Requires a Copilot Token Optimizer installation.
Always read session tallies written by the Cursor Token Optimizer hooks (~/.cursor/token-optimizer/sessions/). Requires a Cursor Token Optimizer installation.
tokenOptimizer.runtime.markdownDescription: Which AI coding assistant runtime to read Token Optimizer data from. **auto** (default) picks whichever of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor you used most recently. Set it explicitly to `claude`, `copilot`, or `cursor` to pin one. Changing this setting takes effect immediately without reloading VS Code.

tokenOptimizer.staleAfterSeconds.markdownDescription: How many seconds before verified statusline usage-limit data is shown as cached. Cached values show their update age; manual refresh also tries a local transcript estimate.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
